Usage: tclaude [options] [command]

tclaude wrapper for Claude Code.

Commands:
  login                         Sign in
  logout                        Sign out and clear the local session
  update [options] [version]    Update the CLI binary (default) or the internal Claude Code package (--claude)
  daemon <stop|restart|status>  Manage the background gateway daemon

Options:
  -v, --version   Show wrapper and upstream Claude Code versions
  -h, --help      display help for command

Forwarding:
  All other args are forwarded to upstream Claude Code as-is.
  `tclaude -h` and `tclaude --help` show wrapper help.
  To show upstream help, run: `tclaude -- -h`
